headline: 17 goals: Messi becomes World Cup's all-time leading scorer
summary: The Argentine captain overtakes Miroslav Klose to claim the record after scoring against Austria.
details: Argentine maestro Lionel Messi has become the highest goalscorer in World Cup history, scoring against Austria to reach a total of 17 goals.
The Argentina captain had an early chance to break the record with a penalty, but it was saved. However, he found the net later in the first half with a clinical finish.
Messi had previously drawn level with former Germany striker Miroslav Klose's tally of 16 goals after scoring a hat-trick against Algeria in the tournament's opening match.
This latest landmark is a testament to the 2022 World Cup-winning captain's continued ability to rewrite the football record books on the sport's biggest stage.
caption:
17 goals and a new world record! 🇦🇷

Argentine maestro Lionel Messi has become the highest goalscorer in World Cup history, scoring against Austria to reach a total of 17 goals.

The Argentina captain had an early chance to break the record with a penalty, but it was saved. However, he found the net later in the first half with a clinical finish.

Messi had previously drawn level with former Germany striker Miroslav Klose's tally of 16 goals after scoring a hat-trick against Algeria in the tournament's opening match.

This latest landmark is a testament to the 2022 World Cup-winning captain's continued ability to rewrite the football record books on the sport's biggest stage.

#Messi #WorldCup #Argentina #Football #RecordBreaker

Source: bdnews24.com, Somoy News

headline_marked: PM Tarique begins 3-day visit as [[he arrives in Dalian, China]]
headline: PM Tarique begins 3-day visit as he arrives in Dalian, China
summary: The Prime Minister has landed in Dalian to start an official three-day visit, preceding scheduled bilateral talks in Beijing.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has arrived in Dalian, China, marking the start of an official three-day government visit.
The visit begins in Dalian before the Prime Minister is scheduled to travel to Beijing for high-level bilateral talks.
The trip is aimed at strengthening diplomatic ties and discussing key issues of mutual interest between Bangladesh and China.
The Prime Minister was received by officials upon his arrival in Dalian to commence the itinerary.
caption:
Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has landed in China! 🇧🇩🇨🇳

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has arrived in Dalian, China, marking the start of an official three-day government visit.

The visit begins in Dalian before the Prime Minister is scheduled to travel to Beijing for high-level bilateral talks.

The trip is aimed at strengthening diplomatic ties and discussing key issues of mutual interest between Bangladesh and China.

The Prime Minister was received by officials upon his arrival in Dalian to commence the itinerary.
